request.zh: 客户经理要能把自己客户还没发货的订单「挂起」，只有店主能解除，解除后回到挂起前的状态。挂起中的订单不能发货，仍算没发货的订单。
request.en: Account managers can put their own customers’ unshipped orders on hold; only the owner can release them, back to the state before the hold. Orders on hold cannot ship and still count as not shipped.

text.en: Jonah can put order 1104 (paid) on hold

checks.expectContains: 订单 1104：已付款 → 挂起中

text.zh: 挂起的订单仍算没发货：没发货的订单 34
text.en: Held orders still count as not shipped: 34 orders not shipped

text.zh: 订单多出「挂起中」这一类
text.en: Orders gain the On hold state
